name: BenQ GV32
summary: BenQ GV32 ships with telemetry, ads and preloaded apps. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: The BenQ GV32 portable projector ships with telemetry, ads and partner services that install apps. It also has unused preloaded apps. The list is short, at 8 apps, and splits them into a first batch of tracking and ads and a second batch of apps that are your choice.

Projector features such as auto focus, auto keystone, zoom and eye protection run through a service that TidyTV keeps on. Turning off the setup wizard can give back the home screen but can break Chromecast built-in casting. TidyTV turns the rest off from your phone with a backup first. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: Auto focus, auto keystone and zoom
Bluetooth remote pairing and remote updates
Live TV, HDMI inputs and the TV service
Factory and test packages, never opened
notes: Turning off the setup wizard gives back the home screen but can break casting with Chromecast built-in. Keep it if you cast.
The factory test apps are kept and are never opened.

faq.q: Will auto focus and keystone still work on my BenQ GV32?
faq.a: Yes. The services that run them are kept on purpose.
Yes by default. Only turning off the setup wizard can break Chromecast built-in casting, so leave that one on if you cast.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns the apps back on and puts the Google TV home screen back in one tap.
